title: Bounded-constructible localizing category, inclusion and fixed-line derived tensor
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a scheme, with pulled-back coefficient ring $\Lambda_X$ as in [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $D_X=D(\mathrm{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}(X_{\mathrm{proet}}))$ and let $\mathrm D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ be the bounded constructible object property of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Using the localizing closure of [sk-def-localizing-closure], define $\mathcal T_X=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathrm D^b_c(X,\Lambda))$ as the full subcategory of $D_X$ and $\iota_X:\mathcal T_X\hookrightarrow D_X$ as its full inclusion. For a specified $\Lambda_X$-module $L$, define $T_L:D_X\to D_X$ by $T_L(K)=K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\Lambda_X}L[0]$, on both objects and morphisms by fixing the second argument of the derived tensor bifunctor [def-sfb-derived-tensor-modules]. No theorem about an exceptional adjoint is used in these definitions.
